messages:
Maya: Heads-up team — prepping QBR for KeplerHealth next Tue. Onboarding looks healthy but token usage spiked last week. Need: 1) updated spend forecast 2) budget alert levels 3) enablement checklist + feedback capture plan. Can owners drop numbers by EOD? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Alex: I'll pull daily token burn + top 5 endpoints. Preliminary: embeddings-heavy project + 1x chat pipeline. Will post numbers in thread by 2pm.
Priya: FYI ran a quick projection — baseline Q2 monthly spend $9.4k -> expected $16.2k with current growth. Major driver: embedding calls (60%). Suggest alert thresholds: warn at 75% of retainer, throttle at 90%. Also recommend temporary 512->256 embed dim when latency > 200ms. I'll attach simple table:
Priya: ```
Scenario | Monthly
Baseline | $9,400
Growth (current trend) | $16,200
Aggressive (embed campaign) | $24,800
Recommended alert policy: 75%/90%
```
Sam: I'll run a short enablement workshop with their engineering leads — focus on batching, prefix caching, and light quantization. Can do Wed 11am PT. Need a one-pager and the small eval prompt set. I'll also capture friction points during session.
Jordan: Renewal signal: account on 6/15 renewal, their CFO asked for a conservative run-rate. If QBR shows +70% spend, they'll ask for committed pricing. Flagging for AE follow-up.
Alex: Numbers posted — snippet: `last7d tokens: 1.1M -> daily avg 157k; embeddings calls/day +120% WoW`. Also noted a spike from "/embed-bulk" endpoint during import job.
Priya: Recommend temporary quota rule for /embed-bulk: soft cap 200req/min + queue with 30s ttl. Also set notify@kepler and notification to CS when projected monthly > $20k.
Maya: Action items: Alex -> finalize token burn + attach breakdown; Priya -> create alert + draft note to customer with thresholds; Sam -> one-pager + workshop slides; Jordan -> pre-QBR AE sync and renewal options. I'll compile into the QBR deck.
Sam: Also want to capture feedback: short post-workshop survey with 3 Qs: 1) Was latency/cost tradeoff acceptable? 2) Any blockers to adopting batching? 3) Topics for follow-up. I'll add to workshop slides.
Priya: Quick ask — what retainer are they on? (so we can set correct 75%/90%).
Jordan: On file: retainer = $30k/month commit.
Maya: Great — Priya use 22.5k (75%) and 27k (90%) as thresholds. Alex paste channel logs and notable timestamps for the import job.
Alex: Pasting short log snippet: ```
[2026-03-18 03:12 UTC] /embed-bulk start -> 23k req in 2h
[2026-03-18 05:20 UTC] spike resolved after client paused job
```
Sam: I'll draft the email template for alert + recommended mitigation steps (batch size, retry backoff, run at off-peak). Want to review before sending.
Maya: Please tag me on drafts. Also capture customer sentiment during workshop — if they mention pricing sensitivity, escalate to Jordan immediately.
onboard-bot: billing-alert: KeplerHealth projection crossed 75% threshold -> notified @Priya @Maya
Priya: Thanks bot. I'll update alert to include AE and customer contact. Will set escalation to CS Pager after 80%.
Maya: Thanks all. Final QBR deck target: Fri COB. If anyone can't make EOD, ping me with what you have. :thumbsup:
